lead: Test build 0.8.29 (CI run 39577249656). New since the first part of the round: the browser works like the original's - drag patches from a library onto a RAM slot or into a library, swap within a bank, Alt+click rename, Undo last operation, Delete selection, Sort alphabetically, Download entire bank (E294-E303); library positions with gaps like the original; single program numbers in the browser; knobs turned on the Virus become host edits while the plug-in window is open, so Ableton Live's Configure mode adds them (issue #10). Linux: the browser and #10 were tested on dev builds; hil.sh runs the core items on this CI build. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Never store a patch on the Virus with the Virus' own STORE button.
Browser tests write into the Virus' RAM: use only RAM A slots 24-31 and the test libraries (LinuxTest, WinTest, MacTest). Undo puts a drop back.
Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows 11 VM, then macOS. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Already installed by Claude: the CI build (install.sh; plug-in dc13ca8b.., broker cdf3d914..).
Claude runs hil.sh on this build (cold start, reopen x2, export, broker kill) and reports the result here.

items.title: Bank sync at start-up
steps: Open a project with the plug-in (Virus on) and wait until the start page is gone; then watch the Virus' display until the bank sync has finished (about half a minute; you can play meanwhile).
items.expect: the Virus' display says the synchronization is done; Claude checks that the log says 'bank sync done in N s'.

items.title: Browser and #10 on the CI build (short)
steps: BROWSER page: lower pane RAM A, upper pane a library. Drag one patch onto RAM A slot 24, then right-click: Undo last operation (the slot gets its old patch back).
Turn a knob on the Virus with the plug-in window open; REAPER's FX window: Param shows it as last touched.
items.expect: the drop and the undo work, the numbers in both panes are single and sharp, the knob is REAPER's last touched parameter.

sections.title: Windows 11 VM
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live 11, Virus attached by Claude
prep: Already installed by Claude: setup.exe /quiet (entry 0.8.29, same plug-in as the CI MSI), C:\tirevive-test\0.8.29-ci.
Ask Claude to attach the Virus to the VM (it stops the Linux broker first).

items.title: Classic oscillator display
steps: Open the editor's oscillator page and choose a few classic waves (saw, pulse, a few wave table entries) on oscillator 1 and 2.
items.expect: the wave picture follows the choice and looks like a normal wave, no empty or broken drawing.

items.title: Browser
steps: SAVE on part 1 > Personal Libraries > Create Empty Library, name it WinTest.
Upper pane OS5 New Features, lower pane WinTest: drag 2 patches onto position 0. Lower pane RAM A: drag 1 patch onto slot 25, then Undo last operation.
Alt+click a WinTest entry and rename it; right-click Sort alphabetically.
items.expect: the patches land where dropped, undo restores slot 25, rename and sort work, the dragged entries and the target slot turn blue while dragging.

items.title: Ableton Configure mode (#10)
steps: Plug-in window open. In Live click Configure on the TI Revive device, then turn a knob on the Virus (e.g. Cutoff), then click Configure again.
items.expect: the parameter of that knob is added to the device's parameter list (as with the original Virus Control).

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude copies the package (CI run 39577249656) to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.29-ci2-mac when the Mac is awake; then: sudo installer -pkg "$HOME/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.29-ci2-mac/TI-Revive-0.8.29-mac/TI Revive.pkg" -target /. Virus on the Mac.
Claude puts diag.on in the plug-in's folder and renames the old diag.log.

items.title: Classic oscillator display
steps: Open the editor's oscillator page and choose a few classic waves (saw, pulse, a few wave table entries) on oscillator 1 and 2.
items.expect: the wave picture follows the choice and looks like a normal wave, no empty or broken drawing.

items.title: Bank sync at start-up
steps: Open a project with the plug-in (Virus on) and wait until the start page is gone; then watch the Virus' display until the bank sync has finished (about half a minute; you can play meanwhile).
items.expect: the Virus' display says the synchronization is done; Claude checks that the log says 'bank sync done in N s'.

items.title: Browser
steps: SAVE on part 1 > Personal Libraries > Create Empty Library, name it MacTest.
Upper pane OS5 New Features, lower pane MacTest: drag 2 patches onto position 0. Lower pane RAM A: drag 1 patch onto slot 26, then Undo last operation.
Alt+click a MacTest entry and rename it; right-click Sort alphabetically.
items.expect: the patches land where dropped, undo restores slot 26, rename and sort work, the dragged entries and the target slot turn blue while dragging.

steps: Plug-in window open. In Live 12 click Configure on the TI Revive device, then turn a knob on the Virus (e.g. Cutoff), then click Configure again.
items.expect: the parameter of that knob is added to the device's parameter list (the case of the issue's reporter).
